reason: The cited evidence (E2, E4) directly supports all key premises: it shows that the PtPdCoCuNi HEA forms isolated Pt/Pd sites, XPS and DFT confirm charge transfer to Pt/Pd, and this correlates with a >2× activity enhancement over PtPd/SiO2. E3 provides general background on HEA electronic effects but is not essential. E1 is about a different material (high-entropy MOF) and is not directly relevant to the premises.
premises: High-entropy mixing in PtPdCoCuNi creates isolated Pt and Pd sites
Charge transfer occurs from adjacent transition metals to Pt/Pd
This charge transfer tunes the electronic structure (d-band center) of Pt/Pd
The electronic tuning enhances catalytic hydrogenation activity (e.g., nitrobenzene to aniline)
